name: Villafranca (Spain)
description: Black field with a yellow cross set towards the hoist and a yellow dotted border, shown with a white triangle at the upper fly.
history: The flag of Villafranca is black on both faces, with a cross in gold, of unknown origin, contrasting with the usual colour schemes of the flags of Navarrese municipalities, which generally have a red ground; the black ground has been linked to a possible connection with the plague epidemics.

features.role: white triangle at the upper fly in this depiction
